column3: “for summoning” renders “for the convocation of,” and “for having the camps set out” renders “for the setting out of the camps.”
“an alarm” renders “teru’ah,” a loud blast or shout (also in verses 6–7 and 9).
“the first days of your months” renders “the beginnings of your months.”
“the commandment of the LORD” renders “the mouth of the LORD.”
“according to their armies” renders “by their hosts” (throughout verses 14–28).
“the holy objects” renders “the sanctuary (miqdash),” and “before their arrival” renders “until they came.”
“the order of march” renders “the settings out.”
